implicit_lock_contract.foreign_keys: Pre-lock every referenced parent row at its assigned rank before DML; implicit KEY SHARE locks count in that rank.
implicit_lock_contract.triggers: No trigger may initiate a lock acquisition outside the declared hierarchy.
implicit_lock_contract.rls: RLS predicates are side-effect-free and acquire no row or advisory locks.
implicit_lock_contract.deferred_constraints: All rows reachable by deferred FK/constraint checks are included in the pre-lock plan.
implicit_lock_contract.ddl: DDL runs only in maintenance mode with governed writes disabled.
